triggers.desc: An object property with the `range` format, in the schema or in `options.format`.

hint.desc: Text displayed under the range when there is no error, translated with `t()`.

….desc: Every option is passed as a prop to [QRange](https://quasar.dev/vue-components/range#qrange-api): `min`, `max`, `step`, `minRange`, `maxRange`, `dragRange`, `dragOnlyRange`, `label`, `labelAlways`, `markers`, `markerLabels`, `snap`, `color`, `dense`...

data.desc: An object `{ min, max }` of two numbers (the QRange model), `undefined` when neither end is set. The schema `title` is displayed above the range, the `description` under it. The `min` and `max` sub-properties are validated by AJV like any number.
